Magadang bati, mahal ko.

I trust that this package arrives to you safe and sound. I know you’ll be visiting here soon

— but it felt wrong not to send over a taste of my home when I could. I hope to be able to

lay my eyes on you, my Vosje, in person soon — as my heart and mind longs for you more and

more each day.

In this package are some assortment of chips, candies, chocolates, and biscuits I selected that

hopefully arrived to you in their safe wholes. In this flipbook I provided an explanation of each: their

relevance to me and the Philippines.

Whether you end up liking these snacks or not, I hope you still enjoy experiencing my culture just

the same. I love you, my Sansinukob. My world is much more colorful and brighter with you.

Jij bent mijn alles. Jij bent van mij, en ik ben van jou.

I can’t wait to see you in December.
